name: flywheel-writing-lint
description: Portable Flywheel prose-form linter MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Score prose form from any MCP-capable harness.
interface.longDescription: A stateless MCP companion for Flywheel's writing standard. It scores prose form against register profiles and reports limits; it does not judge truth, quality, authorship, or publication readiness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Score this draft's prose form with Flywheel Writing Lint and keep the does-not-prove limits visible.
